# separate queries: a generic reader that wants to recover a file's
#   value = prose AND children = prose   (S3, prose-region openers)
# and needs no other keyword knowledge. See rxt_format.md's lexical
# rules for what each one does.
# children: what may be INDENTED under the line — none, prose (the
#   indented lines ARE the value), tree (parsed, never validated,
#   never interpreted), or the named scope they live in.

#   agree) | none (see #section surface for the reason).
# wave: which delivery introduces the kind. A row whose wave is
#   above this build's is RECOGNISED and refused BY NAME as NOT IN
#   THIS BUILD, never as an unknown token. The one exception is the
#   RESERVED sentinel (`# wave-reserved:` below): no delivery
#   introduces such a kind, and it refuses BY NAME as RESERVED.
